hints.title: Many sources at once
hints.body: Running a separate search from every gate repeats work. Start one search with every gate already in the queue.

hints.title: Breadth-first search
hints.body: All gates have distance zero. Expanding in first-in, first-out order guarantees that the first time an empty room is reached, it is reached by a shortest path.

hints.title: Treat walls as blockers
hints.body: Only enqueue cells whose current value is exactly the unreachable sentinel. Gates and previously reached rooms are skipped, and walls are never entered.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
grid = copy of rooms
queue = all cells whose value is 0

while queue is not empty:
    r, c = dequeue
    for each orthogonal neighbor (nr, nc) inside the grid:
        if grid[nr][nc] == 2147483647:
            grid[nr][nc] = grid[r][c] + 1
            enqueue (nr, nc)

return grid
```
